ModMetaData.name: Mech Stations
ModMetaData.author: Sanakara
ModMetaData.description:
<color=#CC33FF>~MECH STATIONS~</color> Compact docking stations with module system for mechanoids.
<color=#00C1EA>~FEATURES:~</color> ▸ Docking ports for every mechanoid size: the mech stands on the port itself, so nothing is parked in front of it taking up room. ▸ Assign a mech to a port and it will return there when idle, instead of wandering around the colony. ▸ Attachable modules for automated repair, faster charging and extended wastepack capacity. ▸ A new Overseer mech-mode: <color=#2ECC71>~Docking~</color>. ▸ Docking works like Recharge, except the mech stays put. It charges to full at the nearest available port and holds it, whether the port is assigned to it or not. When no port is free, mechs fall back to vanilla recharger cycling. ▸ Dead Man's Switch is supported. Mechanoids and automatroids can use each other's ports.
<color=#00C1EA>~NOTICE:~</color> ▸ Size split: 1x1 ports take Light and Medium mechs, 3x3 ports take Heavy and Ultra-Heavy. Vanilla's small recharger only takes Light and the large recharger everything from Medium up. ▸ A port with an assigned mech is reserved and will not be used by any other mech. ▸ Assigned mechs return to their port whenever they are idle or low on energy. ▸ Modules are built from the port, not from the build menu. Select a port and use the build buttons on it. ▸ <color=#E8871E>Please note:</color> Ports behave like ordinary rechargers, with one exception: A mech that runs out of energy and enters self-shutdown will not be carried to a port. It needs a vanilla recharger, or it has to sit in self-shutdown until it recharges itself to 15% (vanilla behaviour).
<color=#00C1EA>~COMPATIBILITY:~</color> ▸ Mods that add new mech types should work, as long as those mechs use the vanilla (or DMS) mech system. Ports only check a mech's weight class, nothing else. ▸ Mods that add or change rechargers should be fine too. Mech Stations does not replace vanilla's charging logic - it only redirects a mech to its own station. A mech with an assigned port always returns to it; an unassigned one compares distances and takes whichever is closer, so vanilla and modded rechargers keep working as before.
